headline: Dollar Steady, Gold Near $4,055 After Fed Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged
summary: Gold traded near $4,055 an ounce and the dollar held steady after the Federal Reserve voted 10 to 2 to keep interest rates unchanged, leaving the rate outlook uncertain. Silver slipped 0.86% to $53.92.
why: The Federal Reserve's benchmark interest rate sets the borrowing baseline for global financial markets and heavily influences currency valuations and non-yielding bullion.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold held steady as the Fed pause was counterbalanced by a split vote leaving future cuts uncertain.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: The dollar remained steady as markets digested divided committee votes on the rate path.

why_moved: A 10-2 split decision by the Federal Reserve to hold interest rates paused directional momentum across dollar and precious metal markets.
